Position Overview KBR is seeking a Senior Linux Systems Administrator with an emphasis on automation and orchestration to join our team. The successful candidate will provide systems administration and infrastructure automation support to the Test Resource Management Center’s (TRMC) All Domain Test Range (ADTR) and INDOPACOM Pacific-Rim Multi-Domain Training and Experimentation Capability
eligibility_evidence: KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities.
In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country's most critical role — protecting our national security.
Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of multi-domain operations.
Required Qualifications Security Clearance: Must have an active Top Secret clearance.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Required Qualifications Security Clearance: Must have an active Top Secret clearance. Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience in a Systems Administrator or Systems Engineering role. Linux Proficiency: In-depth knowledge of Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9) system architecture, storage management (LVM), systemd, firewalld, SELinux policies, and Bash/shell scripting. Automation Tooling: Hands-on experience developing, testing, and debugging production Ansible playbooks, inventory structures, and automation workflows. Physical & Travel Requirements: Ability to lift up to 35 lbs; willing to travel up to 20%. Desired Qualifications Container Platforms: Experience with container engines and orchestration platforms (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, or Red Hat OpenShift).
